summary: formationSpots takes optional beams and, when D2's pick has a member within CORRIDOR_HALF (1.5 ship sizes) of a strand, searches lines turned in 15 degree steps (board, then corridor, then plates; else D2's pick with blocked:true); a blocked crew's beams fade (VEIL_ALPHA 0.3) as they pass the ships.

checks.detail: 13 passed: 6 pure cases (no beams = D2 bit for bit; beams off the line unchanged; strand along the line gives a clear on-board line 15/30 degrees round; tiers; 24 directions gives blocked with D2's pick; tiny board gives blocked; no board) and per-pod sweeps over every merge at 7 scales

Pulsar 441 checks (88 attachment/station pairs skipped: another pod's station or no target in scene), Quasar 532 (75 skipped), Harbor 49 (0 skipped). Fallbacks (blocked): 0 of 441, 0 of 532, 0 of 49. Every member of every non-blocked result is at least CORRIDOR_HALF * ship from every strand; every spot inside the board.

checks.cmd: bite check: same sweep with D2's rule alone (no beams)
checks.detail: D2's pick has a member in a corridor in 98 of 441 checks (Pulsar), 49 of 532 (Quasar), 21 of 49 (Harbor); so the search runs and the guarantee is not vacuous.

checks.cmd: npm run typecheck; npm run lint; npm test

deviations: Quasar added to the sweep (packet said Pulsar and Harbor, Quasar if time allowed).
strokeVeiled draws the outer round caps as a half-disc polygon (butt strokes at joints), since Pixi strokes take one cap per stroke.
limitations: The fade (veil) is never exercised by the fixtures: no merge in Pulsar, Quasar or Harbor ended blocked, so the fade was not seen by eye and has no unit test beyond typecheck. The pure rule's blocked path is unit-tested only on synthetic input.

Stills: the gallery's Power link demo (still-gallery-merge-echo.png: strand out, crew up-left, no crossing; still-gallery-merge-first.png) shows crew and strand not crossing, so it does not itself show the search. still-pulsar-vertical.png is a Pulsar merge from the drive, not chosen as one where D2's pick was blocked (the drive cannot tell which targets a merge has); no still of the fade exists.
Corridor is measured from the station's centre, conservative against the rim start; targets are measured to their centres (Mining beam aims at a cut point on the rock face).
The throwaway tests/e2e/d3-stills.spec.ts was deleted as asked.
